language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Welcome to Casa de Carlos! I am Carlos and this is my restaurant. We are currently installing some solar panels to decrease my electricity bill!

Did you know that all energy comes directly or indirectly from the Sun? It's not just the electricity from my solar panels, but all life. For example, plants grow because they get energy from the Sun. So without the Sun, we have no food!!
Energy is everywhere, but what do you really know about energy?
I'm a turtle, so I don't know that much. Can you help?
Hello, I am Tim.
Welcome to Casa de Carlos! I am Carlos and this is my restaurant. We are currently installing some solar panels to decrease my electricity bill!

Did you know that all energy comes directly or indirectly from the Sun? It's not just the electricity from my solar panels, but all life. For example, plants grow because they get energy from the Sun. So without the Sun, we have no food!!
Energy is everywhere, but what do you really know about energy?
I'm a turtle, so I don't know that much. Can you help?

One thing you need to know about energy is that it makes things work or move. The objects around us don't move on their own. Just like someone needs to pedal a bicycle to go forward, energy is needed by everything to function.
Just look around! There are many objects here that require some sort of energy in order to function. Can you match the type of energy needed for each object?

Did you know that there two kinds of energy? You have potential energy and kinetic energy. Potential energy is stored energy. That is energy ready to go. Kinetic energy is energy at work right now.
Potential energy is stored and does not move. Kinetic energy is about motion. Confusing huh?
Can you sort the following into kinetic and potential energy?

All energy comes from the Sun. This can be direct or indirect. An example of direct energy from the Sun is when you feel warm because of the sun rays. An example of indirect energy is when plants grow because of the sunlight and you eat the plant to get energy.

Can you help me find out which of these situations are the result of direct energy from the Sun and
which are indirect?
